title: leucadendron glutinosum
intro: Leucadendron glutinosum, commonly known as the Pineapple Tree or Pinecone Bush, is a plant species native to South Africa. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucadendron glutinosum include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its antioxidant properties which help protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
